evidence_grade.meaning: scientific checks pass and numerical runs are attested

items.authored_reason: The integrable conditional two-photon output distribution is generated from the reconstructed Hamiltonian and bosonic permanent rule.
The chaotic conditional output distribution is independently generated from the paper's random-matrix model without source-pixel fitting.
The Wasserstein distance to Porter-Thomas is computed directly from independent boson-sampling probability ensembles.
The Shannon entropy and Haar reference are independently generated from the reconstructed probability distributions.
The 4-point spectral-form-factor proxy is computed from the same Hamiltonian ensemble and provides the paper's t*=1.79 timing anchor.
The representative chaotic output probability is generated from the paper's OTOC-equivalent boson-sampling mapping.
The integrable representative output probability is independently generated from the reconstructed unitary dynamics.
All chaotic overlap-sector probabilities are computed from independent bosonic amplitudes and averaged by shared-mode class.
The integrable overlap-sector memory structure is reproduced from the same independently generated probability ensembles.
The chaotic participation ratio is computed from all collision-free output probabilities.
The integrable participation ratio is independently generated from the reconstructed distribution ensemble.
The conditional Porter-Thomas sanity check is independently generated for the paper's N0=36, D=28 setting.
This panel studies how the diagnostic times align as mode count grows; the current public artifact is reduced-scale, and the paper-scale scaling sweep is code-ready via the frozen JSON contract.
The minimum PT-distance trend is already visible locally and is backed by a code-ready higher-scale reconstruction path.
The entropy-gap panel is reduced-scale in the current case, so it explicitly carries the same code-ready paper-scale implementation contract as the other scaling panels.
All chaotic collision-free OTOC-equivalent curves are independently generated and grouped by shared-mode overlap.
The integrable all-configuration OTOC panel is generated from the same formula-driven runner without source-curve digitization.
The t^2 and t^4 early-time scalings are derived from the paper's perturbative OTOC expression and verified numerically.
The late-time FFT spectrum is computed from independently generated long-time OTOC traces for the representative output configuration.
The frequency-space participation ratios are independently computed for every non-initial collision-free configuration.
